nodes.description: Public totalSupply state variable of Token, set once in the ReBornEnergyCoin constructor.
mapping(address => uint256) balances declared in StandardToken; holds every holder balance.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed; spender allowances.
Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public decimals uint8 set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Public constant version string 'H0.1'.
StandardToken.transfer: moves balances from msg.sender to _to after an unchecked-subtraction guard.
StandardToken.transferFrom: moves balances from _from to _to and decrements the caller allowance.
Constant balanceOf(_owner) returning the balances mapping entry.
approve(_spender,_value) writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] directly (no zero-first check).
Constant allowance(_owner,_spender) returning the allowed mapping entry.
ReBornEnergyCoin fallback function that unconditionally throws on plain ether transfers.
Old-style constructor minting _initialAmount to msg.sender and setting name/decimals/symbol.
approveAndCall writes the allowance then performs an external _spender.call with caller-supplied data.
msg.sender used as the source of funds in transfer.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner in transferFrom.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender receiving the initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender forwarded as a callback argument in approveAndCall.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value: unchecked subtraction in transfer before Solidity 0.8.
balances[_to] += _value: unchecked addition in transfer.
balances[_to] += _value: unchecked addition in transferFrom.
balances[_from] -= _value: unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value: unchecked allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
_spender.call(...) low-level external call executed after the allowance write in approveAndCall; reentrancy vector.
Parameter _to of transfer, destination of the added balance.
Parameter _value of transfer, amount subtracted and added.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, debited and allowance owner.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, credited destination.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, amount moved.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf, mapping lookup key.
Parameter _spender of approve, allowance key.
Parameter _value of approve, allowance amount written.
Parameter _owner of allowance, lookup key.
Parameter _spender of allowance, lookup key.
Parameter _spender of approveAndCall, allowance key and call target.
Parameter _value of approveAndCall, allowance and callback amount.
Parameter _extraData of approveAndCall, attacker-controlled call payload.
Parameter _initialAmount of the constructor, minted to msg.sender and totalSupply.
Parameter _tokenName of the constructor, assigned to name.
Parameter _decimalUnits of the constructor, assigned to decimals.
Parameter _tokenSymbol of the constructor, assigned to symbol.
balances[msg.sender] = _initialAmount, totalSupply = _initialAmount: constructor minting writes.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value: unconditional allowance overwrite in approve.

edges.reason: transfer executes the unchecked subtraction of the sender balance.
transfer executes the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction from the source balance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction of the caller allowance.
approveAndCall performs a low-level call to _spender, allowing reentrant execution.
Constructor executes the initial minting and metadata writes.
approve executes the unconditional allowance overwrite.
msg.sender keys the balance that is decremented without a safe-math check.
msg.sender determines the balance state used by the transfer addition path.
msg.sender selects the allowance entry checked before the unchecked addition.
msg.sender is the spender whose approval gates the source balance subtraction.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping entry that is decremented unchecked.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written by approve.
msg.sender receives the whole initial supply at construction time.
msg.sender is passed as an argument into the external _spender call payload.
_to is used as the key for the unchecked balance addition in transfer.
_value is the amount subtracted from the sender balance in transfer.
_from is the key of the balance subtracted in transferFrom.
_from indexes the allowance entry decremented in transferFrom.
_to is the key of the balance added in transferFrom.
_value is the amount added to the destination balance.
_value is the amount subtracted from the source balance.
_value is the amount subtracted from the caller allowance.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_value is the raw allowance amount stored by approve.
_spender is the arbitrary address whose code is invoked by the external call.
_value is encoded into the external call payload.
_extraData is attacker-controlled payload forwarded to the reentrant external call.
_initialAmount is minted to msg.sender and assigned to totalSupply.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
Constructor writes the initial entry into balances.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
Constructor sets totalSupply to the initial amount.
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the decimals value.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transfer parameter consumed only by the unchecked balance addition, so it folds into that unsafe operation.
_value is a transfer parameter consumed by the unchecked balance subtraction.
_from is a transferFrom parameter used as the balance debit key.
_to is a transferFrom parameter used as the balance credit key.
_value is a transferFrom parameter subtracted from the allowance.
_owner is a pure read-only lookup parameter of balanceOf.
_spender is an approve parameter written into the allowance write operation.
_value is an approve parameter stored as the allowance value.
_owner is a pure read-only lookup parameter of allowance.
_spender is a pure read-only lookup parameter of allowance.
_spender becomes the target of the low-level external call in approveAndCall.
_value is encoded into the approveAndCall external call payload.
_extraData is the attacker-controlled payload of the approveAndCall external call.
_initialAmount is minted to msg.sender by the constructor write operation.
_tokenName is a constructor parameter assigned to the name state variable.
_decimalUnits is a constructor parameter assigned to the decimals state variable.
_tokenSymbol is a constructor parameter assigned to the symbol state variable.
